olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Prove that for every positive integer $n$ there exists an $n$-digit number divisible by $5^n$ all of whose digits are odd.

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A convex polygon $P$ in the plane is dissected into smaller convex polygons by drawing all of its diagonals. The lengths of all sides and all diagonals of the polygon $P$ are rational numbers. Prove that the lengths of all sides of all polygons in the dissection are also rational numbers.

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement:
Let $n\ne0$. For every sequence of integers
$$A=(a_0,a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n)$$
satisfying
$$0\le a_i\le i$$
for $i=0,1,\ldots,n$, define another sequence
$$t(A)=(t(a_0),t(a_1),t(a_2),\ldots,t(a_n))$$
by setting $t(a_i)$ to be the number of terms in the sequence $A$ that precede the term $a_i$ and are different from $a_i$. Show that, starting from any sequence $A$ as above, fewer than $n$ applications of the transformation $t$ lead to a sequence $B$ such that
$$t(B)=B.$$

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement:
Let $ABC$ be a triangle. A circle passing through $A$ and $B$ intersects segments $AC$ and $BC$ at $D$ and $E$, respectively. Lines $AB$ and $DE$ intersect at $F$, while lines $BD$ and $CF$ intersect at $M$. Prove that
$$MF=MC$$
if and only if
$$MB\cdot MD=MC^2.$$
figure_description: Triangle with secant circle and cevian intersection configuration.

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement:
At the vertices of a regular hexagon are written six nonnegative integers whose sum is $20032003$.

Bert is allowed to make moves of the following form: he may pick a vertex and replace the number written there by the absolute value of the difference between the numbers written at the two neighboring vertices. Prove that Bert can make a sequence of moves, after which the number $0$ appears at all six vertices.
figure_description: Integer transformation process on the vertices of a regular hexagon.
